title: AIND Ephys Hybrid Benchmark Parameters
description: Configuration schema for the AIND ephys hybrid benchmark pipeline. The logging, job_dispatch, preprocessing and spikesorting sections are copied from aind-ephys-pipeline.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the pipeline the parameters are compatible with. This should be updated when default parameters are changed in a way that is not backward compatible.

benchmark.description: sorters: compare the spike sorters in `sorters`. lossy: compare the `compression_cases` with `sorter`.

existing.description: Start from existing hybrid datasets (<session>/<case>/{recording,sorting}.zarr) instead of generating them. An s3:// input is passed to job_dispatch.s3_path and not staged.

sorter.description: Spike sorter used after compression (benchmark: lossy).

compression_cases.description: Compression cases (benchmark: lossy): 'lossless' (no compression step) or a WavPack bits-per-sample value.

package.description: The package name for which to configure logging.

acquisition_name.description: Name of the acquisition being processed (set by the pipeline from data_description.json).

pipeline_name.description: Name of the pipeline (set by the pipeline).

job_dispatch.description: Parameters for the job dispatch step, which generates JSON job files for parallel processing.

split_segments.description: Whether to split recording segments for parallel processing.

split_groups.description: Whether to process different channel groups separately.

debug.description: Whether to run in DEBUG mode (clips recording to a short duration).

debug_duration.description: Duration in seconds of clipped recording in debug mode. Only used if debug is enabled.

skip_timestamps_check.description: Whether to skip the timestamps check.

min_recording_duration.description: Minimum duration in seconds for a recording to be processed. -1 means this check is disabled.

input.description: Which loader to use for data ingestion.

nwb_files.description: Comma-separated paths of the NWB files to load. Only used if input is 'nwb'. If null, the .nwb files in the input folder are loaded.

streaming.description: Stream the raw data from a remote session (e.g. s3://) instead of staging it. Only session metadata JSONs are staged.

remote_path.description: Remote session path to stream from. Filled in by the pipeline from the input path when streaming.

spikeinterface_info.description: Configuration for the spikeinterface loader. Only used when input is 'spikeinterface'.

reader_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments passed to the reader (e.g., {'folder': '/path/to/folder'}).

keep_stream_substrings.description: Stream name substrings to keep (e.g., 'AP' or ['AP', 'LFP']).

skip_stream_substrings.description: Stream name substrings to skip (e.g., 'NIDQ' or ['USB', 'EVENTS']).

probe_paths.description: Path(s) to ProbeInterface JSON file(s). If a dict, keys are stream names and values are probe paths.

max_recordings.description: Existing datasets only: maximum number of recordings, randomly sub-sampled. null or -1 means all.

s3_path.description: Existing datasets only: s3:// root of the hybrid datasets. Set automatically from an s3:// input.

seed.description: Existing datasets only: random seed for the max_recordings sub-sampling.

hybrid_generation.description: Parameters for the hybrid generation step (aind-ephys-hybrid-generation).

min_amp.description: Minimum amplitude (uV) to scale injected templates.

max_amp.description: Maximum amplitude (uV) to scale injected templates.

min_depth_percentile.description: Percentile of channel depths used as minimum depth.

max_depth_percentile.description: Percentile of channel depths used as maximum depth.

num_units.description: Number of hybrid units for each case.

num_cases.description: Number of hybrid cases for each recording.

correct_motion.description: Whether to estimate motion and move the injected templates accordingly.

compression.description: Parameters for the WavPack compression step (aind-ephys-compress). In the lossy benchmark, bps is set per task from compression_cases.

bps.description: WavPack bits per sample. null means lossless.

highpass.description: Whether to highpass the recording prior to compression.

preprocessing.description: Parameters for the preprocessing step (filtering, denoising, motion correction).

job_kwargs.description: SpikeInterface job keyword arguments for parallel processing.

progress_bar.description: Whether to display a progress bar.

mp_context.description: Multiprocessing context to use for parallel processing.

min_preprocessing_duration.description: Minimum recording duration in seconds required to run preprocessing.

filter_type.description: Type of frequency filter to apply.

remove_bad_channels.description: Whether to remove detected bad channels.

max_bad_channel_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of bad channels allowed. If exceeded, the recording is skipped.

denoising_strategy.description: Denoising strategy: common median reference (cmr) or highpass spatial filter (destripe).

default_preprocessing_pipeline.description: Parameters for each step in the default preprocessing pipeline.

phase_shift.description: Parameters for inter-sample phase shift correction.

margin_ms.description: Margin in milliseconds for edge effects.

detect_and_remove_bad_channels.description: Parameters for bad channel detection and removal.

method.description: Method used for bad channel detection.

outside_channels_location.description: Expected location of outside-brain channels on the probe.

n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbor channels to use for detection.

channel_filters.description: List of channel types to filter out.

reference.description: Type of reference: global or local.

operator.description: Operator used for computing the reference.

n_channel_taper.description: Number of channels for tapering. If null, defaults to n_channel_pad.

apply_agc.description: Whether to apply automatic gain control.

agc_window_length_s.description: Window length in seconds for AGC.

highpass_butter_order.description: Order of the Butterworth highpass filter.

highpass_butter_wn.description: Normalized cutoff frequency for the Butterworth filter.

detect_and_remove_artifacts.description: Parameters for detecting and removing artifacts.

recording_to_detect.description: Recording to use for artifact detection.

method.description: Method for artifact detection and removal.

method_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the artifact detection method.

mode.description: Mode for artifact detection and removal.

custom_preprocessing_pipeline.description: Custom preprocessing pipeline configuration. If null, uses the default pipeline.

motion_correction.description: Parameters for motion estimation and correction.

detect_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for peak detection.

select_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for peak selection.

localize_peaks_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for peak localization.

estimate_motion_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for motion estimation.

interpolate_motion_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for motion interpolation.

spikesorting.description: Parameters for the spike sorting step.

hybrid_evaluation.description: Parameters for the hybrid evaluation step (aind-ephys-hybrid-evaluation).

debug_cases.description: If set, only evaluate this many hybrid cases (debug).

skip_motion_correction.description: Whether to skip the sorter's internal motion correction.

min_drift_channels.description: Minimum number of channels required to enable drift correction.

raise_if_fails.description: Whether to raise an error if spike sorting fails.

clear_cache.description: Whether to force PyTorch memory cleanup between runs.

nblocks.description: Number of non-rigid blocks for drift correction. 0 disables drift correction.

do_CAR.description: Whether to apply common average reference.

invert_sign.description: Whether to invert the sign of the data.

nt.description: Number of temporal samples per waveform.

shift.description: Scalar shift to apply to data. If null, computed automatically.

scale.description: Scalar scale to apply to data. If null, computed automatically.

artifact_threshold.description: Threshold for artifact removal. If null, no artifact removal.

nskip.description: Number of batches to skip for drift estimation.

highpass_cutoff.description: Highpass filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

binning_depth.description: Bin size in micrometers for drift estimation.

nt0min.description: Minimum time index for template. If null, computed automatically.

dmin.description: Minimum vertical spacing between channels. If null, computed automatically.

dminx.description: Minimum horizontal spacing between channels in micrometers.

nearest_chans.description: Number of nearest channels for template matching.

nearest_templates.description: Number of nearest templates to consider.

max_channel_distance.description: Maximum channel distance. If null, no limit.

templates_from_data.description: Whether to derive templates from data.

n_pcs.description: Number of principal components for template features.

x_centers.description: X-centers for non-rigid drift correction. If null, computed automatically.

duplicate_spike_ms.description: Time window in milliseconds for duplicate spike removal.

save_preprocessed_copy.description: Whether to save a copy of the preprocessed data.

bad_channels.description: List of bad channel indices. If null, auto-detected.

save_extra_vars.description: Whether to save extra variables for debugging.

keep_good_only.description: Whether to keep only 'good' labeled units.

skip_kilosort_preprocessing.description: Whether to skip Kilosort's internal preprocessing.

use_binary_file.description: Whether to use a binary file. If null, auto-determined.

delete_recording_dat.description: Whether to delete the recording .dat file after sorting.

skip_motion_correction.description: Whether to skip the sorter's internal motion correction.

min_drift_channels.description: Minimum number of channels required to enable drift correction.

raise_if_fails.description: Whether to raise an error if spike sorting fails.

car.description: Whether to apply common average reference.

minFR.description: Minimum firing rate for a unit.

minfr_goodchannels.description: Minimum firing rate for good channels.

nblocks.description: Number of non-rigid blocks for drift correction.

nPCs.description: Number of principal components for features.

nfilt_factor.description: Factor for number of filters (nfilt = nchannels * nfilt_factor).

NT.description: Batch size in samples. If null, auto-determined.

keep_good_only.description: Whether to keep only 'good' labeled units.

skip_kilosort_preprocessing.description: Whether to skip Kilosort's internal preprocessing.

scaleproc.description: Scaling factor for whitened data. If null, auto-determined.

save_rez_to_mat.description: Whether to save rez structure to .mat file.

delete_tmp_files.description: List of temporary file types to delete after sorting.

delete_recording_dat.description: Whether to delete the recording .dat file after sorting.

clustering_ms_before.description: Time in ms before spike peak for clustering.

clustering_ms_after.description: Time in ms after spike peak for clustering.

detection_radius_um.description: Radius in micrometers for spike detection.

features_radius_um.description: Radius in micrometers for feature extraction.

split_radius_um.description: Radius in micrometers for cluster splitting.

template_radius_um.description: Radius in micrometers for template computation.

freq_min.description: Minimum frequency in Hz for bandpass filter.

freq_max.description: Maximum frequency in Hz for bandpass filter.

n_peaks_per_channel.description: Number of peaks per channel for spike selection.

n_svd_components_per_channel.description: Number of SVD components per channel.

n_pca_features.description: Number of PCA features for clustering.

ms_before.description: Time in ms before spike peak for template extraction.

ms_after.description: Time in ms after spike peak for template extraction.

template_min_snr_ptp.description: Minimum peak-to-peak SNR for template acceptance.

template_max_jitter_ms.description: Maximum jitter in milliseconds for template acceptance.

min_firing_rate.description: Minimum firing rate in Hz to keep a unit.

job_kwargs.description: Additional job keyword arguments for Lupin.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If null, no seed is set.

ms_before.description: Time in ms before spike peak.

ms_after.description: Time in ms after spike peak.

regularize.description: Whether to regularize the whitening matrix.

method_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the detection method.
Keyword arguments for the selection method.

apply_motion_correction.description: Whether to apply internal motion correction.

max_distance_um.description: Maximum distance in micrometers for merging.

method_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the clustering method.

sparsify_threshold.description: Threshold for sparsification. If null, no sparsification.

mean_sd_ratio_threshold.description: Threshold on the mean-to-standard-deviation ratio for a cluster.

min_firing_rate.description: Minimum firing rate in Hz to keep a unit.

method_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the matching method.

memory_limit.description: Memory limit as a fraction of available RAM.

multi_units_only.description: Whether to only detect multi-unit activity.

job_kwargs.description: Additional job keyword arguments for SpykingCircus2.

deterministic_peaks_detection.description: Whether to use deterministic peak detection.

do_motion_estimation.description: Whether to estimate motion (drift) before sorting.

already_preprocessed.description: Whether the recording is already preprocessed (e.g. "assume_yes_if_float").

preprocessing_dtype.description: Data type used for preprocessed data.

subsampling_spikes_per_channel.description: Maximum number of spikes per channel used for subsampling.

subsampling_presence.description: Minimum presence fraction for subsampled spikes.

dredge_only.description: Whether to only run motion estimation (DREDge) and skip sorting.

n_jobs_cpu.description: Number of CPU jobs. 0 uses the default.

n_jobs_gpu.description: Number of GPU jobs. 0 uses the default.

motion_n_jobs_gpu.description: Number of GPU jobs for motion estimation.

n_jobs_small.description: Number of jobs for small CPU tasks. Negative values count from the number of CPUs.

n_jobs_small_gpu.description: Number of jobs for small GPU tasks.

work_in_tmpdir.description: Whether to work in a temporary directory.

copy_recording_to_tmpdir.description: Whether to copy the recording to the temporary directory (e.g. "no").

workdir_copier.description: Method used to copy files to the working directory.

workdir_follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symlinks when copying to the working directory.

peak_sign.description: Sign of the peaks to detect.

motion_voltage_threshold.description: Detection threshold used for motion estimation.

nn_denoiser_class_name.description: Class name of the neural network denoiser.

nn_denoiser_pretrained_path.description: Path to pretrained denoiser weights. If null, uses the default.

amplitude_scaling_stddev.description: Standard deviation of the amplitude scaling prior.

rigid.description: Whether to use rigid motion correction.

spatial_bin_length_um.description: Spatial bin length for motion estimation (um).

temporal_bin_length_s.description: Temporal bin length for motion estimation (s).

window_margin_um.description: Margin of non-rigid windows (um). If null, auto-determined.

max_dt_s.description: Maximum time difference for pairwise motion comparison (s).

min_amplitude.description: Minimum amplitude of spikes used for motion estimation. If null, no minimum.

max_dist_from_median_um.description: Maximum distance from the median displacement (um).

median_neighborhood_bins.description: Number of bins in the median neighborhood.

fit_matching_models_only.description: Whether to only fit the matching models.

save_full_final_residual.description: Whether to save the full final residual.

job_kwargs.description: SpikeInterface job keyword arguments for parallel processing.

progress_bar.description: Whether to display a progress bar.

peak_sign.description: Sign of the peak to detect.
